title: Deep Reasoning in General Purpose Agents via Structured Meta-Cognition
abstract: arXiv:2605.11388v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Humans intuitively solve complex problems by flexibly shifting among reasoning modes: they plan, execute, revise intermediate goals, resolve ambiguity through associative judgment, and apply formal procedures to well-specified subproblems. Current LLM agents lack this flexibility, as their scaffolds hard-code such reasoning decisions in advance. These scaffolds are effective when their prescribed structure matches the task, but brittle when solving the task requires adapting the structure of reasoning itself. We introduce Deep Reasoning -- an inference-time approach for constructing task-specific scaffolds through structured meta-reasoning. Deep Reasoning uses a formal language that represents meta-reasoning as executable decompositions over associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, enabling decomposition principles to be encoded as in-context examples that guide test-time scaffold construction. translated_title: 通过结构化元认知在通用智能体中实现深度推理
translated_abstract: 人类通过在不同推理模式之间灵活切换来直观地解决复杂问题：他们进行规划、执行、修改中间目标、通过联想判断消解歧义，并对明确定义的子问题应用形式化程序。当前的LLM智能体缺乏这种灵活性，因为它们的脚手架（scaffold）预先硬编码了此类推理决策。当其规定的结构与任务相匹配时，这些脚手架是有效的，但当解决任务需要调整推理结构本身时，它们就会变得脆弱。我们提出了深度推理（Deep Reasoning）——一种通过结构化元推理在推理时构建任务特定脚手架的方法。深度推理使用一种形式化语言，将元推理表示为对联想推理、形式化计算和递归子问题求解的可执行分解，使分解原则能够被编码为上下文示例，从而指导测试时的脚手架构建。
tldr: 提出“深度推理”方法，利用形式化语言将元推理表示为可执行的分解，在推理时动态构建任务特定的脚手架，使LLM智能体能像人类一样灵活地在联想推理、形式化计算和递归求解等不同推理模式间切换。
en_tdlr: Introduces Deep Reasoning, an inference-time approach that uses a formal language to represent meta-reasoning as executable decompositions, dynamically constructing task-specific scaffolds that enable LLM agents to flexibly shift among reasoning modes—associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving—like humans do.
